description: This file defines the class `BeanJsonSerializer` which serializes `SugarBean` objects into JSON format, providing methods for converting beans into arrays and JSON strings with options for pretty printing and filtering empty values.

classes.name: BeanJsonSerializer
classes.description: A class to convert SugarBean objects into JSON strings or associative arrays with various formatting and filtering options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer by loading a YAML mapping file.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new BeanJsonSerializer.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean into a JSON string with options for pretty printing and hiding empty values.

methods.name: toArrayOld
methods.description: Deprecated method that converts a SugarBean into a nested associative array with extensive field-specific formatting.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean into a standardized associative array, optionally loading relationships.

methods.name: fixName
methods.description: Standardizes the name structure for person or contact beans.

methods.name: getFieldsAndKeys
methods.description: Retrieves raw field values and keys from a SugarBean object.
